title: Exact module extension by zero with an independent ring universe
statement: Let C:Type c have Hom universe v, J a topology, R a RingCat.{r}-valued sheaf, and U∈C. Put m=max(c,v,r). Assume abelian sheafification and its locally-bijective criterion on J and J/U in universe m. The concrete functor formed by the direct-sum extension presheaf followed by module sheafification is additive, preserves finite limits and finite colimits, and is left adjoint to module restriction to U. No relation between c,v,r or subterminality is required.

source.place: Tags 03DI and 03DJ; the direct-sum proof with independent site and ring universes.

proof.text: Define the extension functor by the direct-sum presheaf followed by module sheafification.

A presheaf map out of a direct sum is a compatible family of maps on the summands. Including the structure-map summand gives the inverse. Check both inverse identities and naturality on each summand; compose with the sheafification Hom equivalence to obtain the adjunction.

Restriction is additive sectionwise, so its left adjoint is additive and preserves finite colimits. Evaluation takes monomorphisms to injections; the direct sum of injections is injective. Presheaf extension and then left exact module sheafification preserve monomorphisms. The abelian exactness criterion for a right exact additive functor preserving monomorphisms gives finite-limit preservation.

proof_origin.place: E9: the proof in the Lean module, with the source argument specialized to the stated slice-site interface.

theorem siteModuleExtensionByZero_exact
    [HasSheafify (J.over U) AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]

    (siteModuleExtensionByZero R U).Additive ∧
